admission.justification: Spans short_answer.py and read_files_briefs.py, is guarded by test_short_answer_gates_read_current_brief_notices_on_location_current, and prevents callers from being told to open missing or stale brief files.

applicability: File-brief short-answer row notices and batch counts-only notices emitted by read_ar_files.
conditions: Emits open-the-brief guidance (IN_THE_FILE, LEFT_OUT, RULE_LEFT_OUT, and current counts_notice) only when on-disk brief freshness marks location.current true.
Emits honest not-current notices directing callers to knowledge_read or current briefs only whenever a saved brief is missing or older than the selected memory tree.
exclusions: Does not write or refresh saved brief files on disk during read_ar_files.
Applies to converted-memory file briefs; paths without an eligible brief omit brief notices.
statement: read_ar_files short answers direct callers to open the current brief file only when location.current is true and report missing or older briefs honestly otherwise.
title: read_ar_files short-answer brief notices gated on location.current
